# Checklist configuration GitHub Actions

Copier cette liste dans GitHub → **Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions**.

## Variables

- [ ] `SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF`
- [ ] `VITE_SUPABASE_URL`
- [ ] `MBEUK_HUB_URL`
- [ ] `MBEUK_PRODUCT_ID`
- [ ] `MBEUK_APPLICATION_ID`
- [ ] `MBEUK_ENVIRONMENT` (`production`)
- [ ] `VERCEL_ORG_ID`
- [ ] `VERCEL_PROJECT_ID`
- [ ] `SUPABASE_DB_PUSH_ON_MAIN` (`false` par défaut)

## Secrets

- [ ] `SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN`
- [ ] `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`
- [ ] `VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`
- [ ] `VERCEL_TOKEN`
- [ ] `MBEUK_HUB_API_KEY`
- [ ] `MBEUK_AUTH_BRIDGE_SECRET`
- [ ] `BYOK_MASTER_KEY_BASE64`
- [ ] `ADMIN_SECRET`
- [ ] `CRAWLER_CRON_SECRET`
- [ ] Clés IA centrales (optionnel) : `CENTRAL_*`
